scope: Local delta top-k optimization only. No native host operations or timing results in this evidence. Historical unpruned evidence remains unchanged.
behavior: Count every exact matching delta record before pruning, preserving delta_candidates.
Select delta top-k by total float distance then stable ID using select_nth_unstable_by, truncate, and sort retained k.
Every base search attempt clones at most k delta hits. The common merge helper also partially selects before sorting.
Any delta record below its own exact top-k has at least k better delta records and cannot enter the merged top-k; base/delta identities are disjoint after shadow filtering.
unpruned_baseline_note: Root archived lifecycle-v2-unpruned-sources.tar.gz and synchronized it before this edit. Native timing is separately coordinated.
limits: This change retains all matching-delta distance evaluations. It reduces selection/sorting and retry clone work, not the O(number of matching delta records) scan.
